content.name: Scarab of Protection
entries: If you hold this beetle-shaped medallion in your hand for 1 round, an inscription appears on its surface revealing its magical nature. It provides two benefits while it is on your person:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

The scarab has 12 charges. If you fail a saving throw against a necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an undead creature, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last charge is expended.

content.name: Scarab of Protection
entries: This beetle-shaped medallion provides three benefits while it is on your person.

entries.name: Defense
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}.

entries.name: Preservation
entries: The scarab has 12 charges. If you fail a saving throw against a Necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an Undead, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to expend 1 charge and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last charge is expended.

entries.name: Spell Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells.
